about: Saint-Colomban is a city in the Lower Laurentians north of Montréal, inland from Mirabel and Saint-Jérôme. Wooded residential neighbourhoods and small commercial nodes dominate rather than a dense downtown; Highway 15 and regional roads tie it to the North Shore job market. About 17,000 people live in Saint-Colomban.
